title: Sustained impact of higher customer satisfaction on bank revenue
core_idea: Using survey responses linked to objective bank records for 19,060 Swedish retail customers, the study investigates whether customer satisfaction predicts individual-level bank revenue growth and whether that impact is sustained over one to four years and varies across satisfaction tiers.
tldr: Analyzes whether and how customer satisfaction levels are associated with sustained individual bank revenue growth over 1–4 years, and whether effects differ across satisfaction groups, using linked survey and transactional data.
